                <p>Raheem Sterling scored a hat-trick in just 11 minutes as Manchester City breezed past Atalanta 5-1 in the UEFA Champions League on Tuesday.</p>
                <p>The Englishman hit his first in the 58th minute to make the score 3-1 after Sergio Aguero's first half brace cancelled out Ruslan Malinovskiy's opener from the penalty spot.</p>
                <p>He added a superb second six minutes later, cutting inside the Atalanta defender Rafael Toloi and powering the ball into the near corner.</p><div class="in-post-sticky  only-desktop"><div class="ad-callout-wrapper ad-label headline-medium only-desktop">
                        <div data-bi-ad="" id="gam-post-sports-in_content_1-desktop-1" class="ad ad-wrapper fluid in-post only-desktop" data-force="" data-type="ad" data-adunit="businessinsider.desktop/post/in-content-1/sports" data-region="in-content-1" data-responsive="[{"browserLimit":[0,0],"slotSize":[[6,1],[300,50],[300,250],[320,50],[320,100],[320,480],"fluid"]},{"browserLimit":[600,0],"slotSize":[[300,250],[600,480],[728,90],[800,480],"fluid"]}]" data-tile-order="tile-1" data-targeting="{"adunit":"businessinsider.desktop/post/in-content-1/sports","region":"in-content-1","dvp_spos":"in-content-1"}" data-not-lazy="" data-enable-destroy-slots="true" data-enable-ad-refresher="true" data-refresh-count="0"></div>
                      </div></div>
                <p>And the hat-trick was complete shortly after in the 69th minute when he prodded home substitute Riyad Mahrez's cross from close range.</p>
                <p><strong>Watch his third goal here:</strong></p><div class="in-post-sticky  only-desktop"><div class="ad-callout-wrapper ad-label headline-medium only-desktop">
                        <div data-bi-ad="" id="gam-post-sports-in_content_2-desktop-2" class="ad ad-wrapper fluid in-post only-desktop" data-force="" data-type="ad" data-adunit="businessinsider.desktop/post/in-content-2/sports" data-region="in-content-2" data-responsive="[{"browserLimit":[0,0],"slotSize":[[6,1],[300,50],[300,250],[320,50],[320,100],[320,480],"fluid"]},{"browserLimit":[600,0],"slotSize":[[300,250],[600,480],[728,90],[800,480],"fluid"]}]" data-tile-order="tile-2" data-targeting="{"adunit":"businessinsider.desktop/post/in-content-2/sports","region":"in-content-2","dvp_spos":"in-content-2"}" data-enable-destroy-slots="true" data-enable-ad-refresher="true" data-refresh-count="0"></div>
                      </div></div>
                <div data-type="embed" data-embed-type="twitter"><blockquote class="twitter-tweet blockquote" data-lang="en" data-cards="" data-conversation="">—Bleacher Report Live  (@brlive) <a href="https://twitter.com/mims/statuses/1186743558440734721?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw" rel=" nofollow" target="_blank">October 22, 2019</a></blockquote>  <div class="script" data-lazy-load="script" data-load-strategy="lazy" data-root-margin="100% 0px" data-src="//platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" data-async="true"></div>
                </div>
                <p><strong>Or here if you're in a different region:</strong></p>
                <div data-type="embed" data-embed-type="twitter"><blockquote class="twitter-tweet blockquote" data-lang="en" data-cards="" data-conversation="">—Football on BT Sport  (@btsportfootball) <a href="https://twitter.com/mims/statuses/1186742483704786951?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw" rel=" nofollow" target="_blank">October 22, 2019</a></blockquote></div>
                <p>Sterling's hat-trick was the third quickest in Champions League history, behind only Mike Newell's nine minute effort for Blackburn Rovers against Rosenborg in the 1995-1996 seaosn, and Bafetimbi Gomis' astonishing seven minute trio of goals for Olympique Lyonnais in the 2011-2012 campaign.</p><div class="in-post-sticky  only-desktop"><div class="ad-callout-wrapper ad-label headline-medium only-desktop">
                        <div data-bi-ad="" id="gam-post-sports-in_content_3-desktop-3" class="ad ad-wrapper fluid in-post only-desktop" data-force="" data-type="ad" data-adunit="businessinsider.desktop/post/in-content-3/sports" data-region="in-content-3" data-responsive="[{"browserLimit":[0,0],"slotSize":[[6,1],[300,50],[300,250],[300,600],[320,50],[320,100],[320,480],"fluid"]},{"browserLimit":[600,0],"slotSize":[[300,250],[600,480],[728,90],[800,480],"fluid"]}]" data-tile-order="tile-3" data-targeting="{"adunit":"businessinsider.desktop/post/in-content-3/sports","region":"in-content-3","dvp_spos":"in-content-3"}" data-enable-destroy-slots="true" data-enable-ad-refresher="true" data-refresh-count="0"></div>
                      </div></div>
                <p><em><strong>Read more:</strong> <a href="https://www.businessinsider.com/raheem-sterling-good-as-messi-ronaldo-says-former-city-star-2019-9" data-track-click="{"element_name":"body_link","event":"tout_click","index":"bi_value_unassigned","product_field":"bi_value_unassigned"}" rel="" target="_self">A former Manchester City and England star says Raheem Sterling is just as good as Messi and Ronaldo</a></em></p>
                <p>Sterling's three goals takes his total for the season to 12 in all competitions, making him City's joint top scorer alongside Sergio Aguero, <a href="https://www.businessinsider.com/the-15-highest-goalscorers-in-european-football-right-now-2019-10#ciro-immobile-ss-lazio-8-goals-9" data-track-click="{"element_name":"body_link","event":"tout_click","index":"bi_value_unassigned","product_field":"bi_value_unassigned"}" rel="" target="_self">as well as Europe's third highest goal-getter so far this term.</a></p>

                  </div>
                
                <p>The 24-year-old also managed two assists on the night, teeing up Sergio Aguero for City's equalizer in the 34th minute, before winning the penalty from which the Argentine equalized in the 38th.</p>
                <p>The former FC Barcelona and England striker Gary Lineker was quick to hail Sterling's performance on Twitter, saying: "Sterling has been good tonight. Scored two, created one and won the penalty for the other. Terrific."</p><div class="in-post-sticky  only-desktop"><div class="ad-callout-wrapper ad-label headline-medium only-desktop">
